=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1082-1231 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `_pr_ensure_final_ci` header (lines 1082-1098) names `scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh` as the only source of `PR_FINAL_CI_WIRING_NO_UPDATE=true`. It does not mention the branch at lines 1221-1231 that turns on check-only mode itself when `pr_json` carries the `e2e-smoke-test` label, and it does not say that this label check runs only when `pr_json` was actually read.
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime today, but callers that pass a head ref plus `PR_FINAL_CI_BASE_REF` never read `pr_json`, so they silently bypass the e2e protection; `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` (line 1341) is one such caller. A future caller could therefore update an e2e PR's branch mid-gate. All three reviewers rated this NIT, mapped here to low; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised it as a hardening suggestion and called it the only grounded finding. The suggested fix is one sentence after line 1089, about 2 lines.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "G4. The check costs no extra API call per PR per tick in the common case. Compare blob SHAs from data the caller already has, or from one cached read of the base's workflow blob SHAs per cycle (§15)." (issue #9993 G4)
  expected_change_site: `_pr_ensure_final_ci` wiring hook (lines 1208-1231) and `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update` compare read (~line 2461) in `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh`, plus `scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh` as the caller
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: `scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:340` calls `_pr_ensure_final_ci "${REPOSITORY}" "${number}" "${sha}" "${ref}"` with no base ref, no freshness side channel and no cached workflow SHA, so every sweep candidate pays one `GET pulls/<pr>` (`scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1217`) and one `GET compare/<head>...<base>` (`scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2461`), and the diff adds no per-cycle cache anywhere, while held heads (`no_update_path`, a recorded refusal, a lease wait) pay those calls again every tick, plus `GET user` and the comments read, and `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update` reuses `PR_BASE_FRESHNESS_BASE_PATHS` only for the merge path (line 2452). The merge paths meet G4 at 0 calls via `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge`, and the cost is documented in the helper header (lines 2351-2353) and capped by `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK`. Earlier rounds deferred this (`TASK_GAP_DEFERRED: G4 sweep cost`) because the sweep file is outside the grant. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and minimax_minimax-m3 rated it NIT, openai_gpt-6-luna rated it MAJOR, and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash declined to re-flag it as an accepted residual.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1082-1098 vs 1221-1231 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `_pr_ensure_final_ci` header names `scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh` as the only source of check-only mode. It omits the `final_ci_wiring_no_update="true"` path the last run added for `pr_json` that carries the `e2e-smoke-test` label. It also does not say that `pr_json` is read only when no head ref was passed (line 1190), or when neither `PR_FINAL_CI_BASE_REF` nor the freshness side channel supplied a base ref (line 1217).
  WHY: Nothing fails today, and the sweep path is covered by `test_e2e_labelled_pr_is_never_updated_by_the_sweep_path`. But `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` (line 1341) always passes `PR_FINAL_CI_BASE_REF`, and the review merge path passes a head ref, so the e2e protection silently depends on the caller's arguments. Fix: add one sentence after line 1089 (about 2 lines).
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "G4. The check costs no extra API call per PR per tick in the common case. Compare blob SHAs from data the caller already has, or from one cached read of the base's workflow blob SHAs per cycle (§15)."
  Expected change site: wiring hook in `_pr_ensure_final_ci` (lines 1208-1231) and the "behind" decision in `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update` (compare read at about line 2461) in `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh`; a process-wide cache belongs in this file, so no change to `scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh` is needed.
  Evidence of absence: The merge paths meet G4 at 0 calls via `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge`, but the sweep does not: `scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:340` passes no base ref or freshness side channel, so every candidate pays `GET pulls/<pr>` (line 1217) and `GET compare/<head>...<base>`. Held heads pay again every tick, plus `GET user` and the comments read. The PR adds no per-cycle cache. Earlier rounds deferred this as outside the grant; the cost is documented and capped by `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK`.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- HARDENING: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_pr_ensure_final_ci` header, after line 1089: add "A PR read that carries the `e2e-smoke-test` label (made only when no head ref or no base ref was known) also turns on check-only mode." Estimated lines changed: 2. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh: header comment block at lines 1082-1098, vs. self-set check-only branch at lines 1221-1229 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The header documents only `scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh` as the source of `PR_FINAL_CI_WIRING_NO_UPDATE=true`. It omits the defense-in-depth branch at lines 1221-1229 for the `e2e-smoke-test` label and does not say that branch is gated on `[ -n "${pr_json}" ]`. `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` (line 1341) passes `PR_FINAL_CI_BASE_REF` and a head ref, so `pr_json` stays empty there and the branch is bypassed.
  WHY: Current callers are safe by construction: the non-merging exits set the flag explicitly, the sweep reads `pr_json`, and the normal auto-merge path tolerates the update. The header is incomplete, though, and a future caller that passes `PR_FINAL_CI_BASE_REF` for an e2e PR without setting the flag would update the branch mid-gate.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "The check costs no extra API call per PR per tick in the common case. Compare blob SHAs from data the caller already has, or from one cached read of the base's workflow blob SHAs per cycle (§15)." (issue #9993 G4)
  Expected change site: The final-CI sweep path (`scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh`) and the wiring check in `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh` that it calls.
  Evidence of absence: `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update` reuses `PR_BASE_FRESHNESS_BASE_PATHS` for the merge path (line 2452), but no per-cycle base-workflow-SHA cache was added for the sweep. Each sweep candidate pays `GET pulls/<pr>` (line 1217) plus `GET compare/<head>...<base>` (line 2461). The diff does not touch `scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh`, which is outside the grant. The cost is documented in the helper header (lines 2351-2353) and bounded by `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK`. The consolidator deferred it (`TASK_GAP_DEFERRED: G4 sweep cost`) and `anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5` accepted the deferral.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
